C-ASTRA-OCR-BUNDLE-353.Summary: Publish and verify target-specific Debian 12, Astra Linux 1.7 and Astra Linux 1.8 offline bundles so Tesseract rus+eng, Poppler and LibreOffice are actually present and recoverable on the target OS.
C-ASTRA-OCR-BUNDLE-353.Problem: The runtime installer already requires document capabilities and persists a verified repair payload, but the universal GitHub Release workflow builds its only native archive inside node:24-bookworm. Release 0.4.5 therefore publishes only a Debian 12 package closure. On Astra Linux the installer correctly rejects that OS-package layer as incompatible, leaving no published matching bundle that can install Tesseract, language data, Poppler and LibreOffice offline.

Goals.Goal: Build one immutable full bundle per supported release series — Debian 12, Astra 1.7 and Astra 1.8 — from the same exact main SHA.
Build Astra package closures only inside official matching Astra Linux UBI reference environments and never relabel Debian packages as Astra.
Run the existing install/update/repeat/rollback systemd acceptance against the same matching target family before any archive is publishable.
Make the common installer choose the unique compatible archive when several target bundles are stored together, and fail before system mutation on no match or ambiguity.
Keep additive-only package installation, strict OCR/PDF/Office preflight and the immutable installer-owned repair cache unchanged.

Constraints.Constraint: The verified base is main commit 2a5cbef380745af52485e8b55642a916d4ad9dfd with tree f08a9c42c0704bb26374e3d3d47f0cb0d9db5645; issue 353 is the acceptance authority.
SQLite schema 31, applied migrations, document evidence, application dependencies and VERSION 0.4.5 are unchanged by this implementation PR.
Docker/container images are allowed only as disposable release/reference environments in CI; production deployment remains native systemd without Docker.
Astra builds use official registry.astralinux.ru UBI images for their own series; the archive records the actual source OS version and architecture in source-os.env.
Target package operations remain additive-only: no package pinning, upgrade, downgrade, removal, allow-downgrades or automatic apt --fix-broken.
The same archive that passes target install/update/rollback verification is the archive uploaded to the release; verification may not rebuild or substitute it.
Do not add a second or version-specific release workflow. Extend the existing universal Release workflow.
Do not weaken fail-closed full-bundle activation, strict Tesseract rus+eng/Poppler/LibreOffice doctor checks or package-cache checksum/profile validation.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Publish, replace or mutate an existing GitHub Release from this implementation PR.
Change OCR recognition algorithms, protocol parsing, document provenance or user data schema.
Make the deterministic application core depend on OCR, Internet, Docker, cloud services or an LLM.
Claim real workstation acceptance solely from container evidence; TARGET_ACCEPTANCE remains required before stable promotion.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The release workflow builds distinct Debian 12, Astra 1.7 and Astra 1.8 amd64 native archives from one exact source SHA and each archive passes verify-bundle before further use.
Each Astra archive contains a source-os.env with OS_FAMILY=astra, the matching normalized series, amd64 architecture, full-airgap-v2 dependency closure and additive-only-v2 target policy.

Each archive is installed with target networking disabled in a matching reference system; API/worker, strict doctor, Tesseract rus+eng, Poppler and LibreOffice pass, then repeated install/update and rollback regression run against that same artifact.
The successful installer-owned OS-package cache remains usable by doctor repair after the original installation directory is unavailable.

The generic installer selects exactly one compatible archive by embedded OS family/series/architecture; zero or multiple compatible archives fail before root package or application mutation and report the target plus available profiles.
An explicitly supplied incompatible archive still fails closed through the existing target profile validation and cannot switch current or migrate data.
Release checksum and asset verification operate on the complete dynamically generated verified asset set rather than assuming exactly seven Debian-only files.
Focused selector/unit tests, shell syntax, docs consistency, ordinary project tests, GRACE final scope and the release/deployment risk gate pass on the exact PR head before merge.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head CI shows three target-specific full bundles, matching systemd install/update/rollback verification and deterministic installer archive selection while existing storage and package-safety invariants remain unchanged.
